name: R-Judge
description: R-Judge is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to judge and identify safety risks in multi-turn agent interactions across diverse scenarios and risk types. It includes 569 interaction records with annotated safety labels and risk descriptions.
reputation: A newer safety benchmark that has seen growing use for evaluating LLMs' ability to detect risks in multi-turn agent settings.
notes: Covers 27 key risk scenarios in 5 application categories and 10 risk types; highlights challenges in risk awareness and multi-dimensional safety judgment.
